notes: No NJIT-wide single AI policy and no school or computing-unit policy found; guidance is split across the Dean of Students statement and the Emerging Technologies pages (course layer deferred). Site navigation in the saved texts was skipped. Template sample text on the Instructor Autonomy page is coded as the rule it would give students if an instructor adopted it; the document stance is delegates with three tiers. Coders' notes: some units are loose fits to the nearest type (P44 benefit statement, P35 on interaction); fit_notes added. Both coders' candidate-type notes: none; new_types empty.
